notes.notes:
Yo, I uploaded first (short) teaser for Rap Simulator, the recording is from the game. Do you know who is rapping it? The song in the game was specially recorded for Rap Simulator. You can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=lLAwa7vgv1s;full][/previewyoutube]

Unfortunately Covid delayed a lot of things (translations, music etc), I also changed the release date of my other games, A few days ago I just released THE IMPOSSIBLE (I should released it before July, but I couldn't...):

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363850/THE_IMPOSSIBLE/

Also, I couldn't put the treaser on Steam earlier because the person who made the music died on Covid-19 .. I had to make a new movie (teaser), everything is delayed and Airem is a one-man studio.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35414793/0342bb56e3a562158e42fc452d60be387134161a.gif

I will probably change the date from Aug 7th 2020 to Aug 20-24th 2020. I don't want to change the date, so I'm doing (right now) what I can. I'll let you know soon. Sorry for the problems and Thank You for your support.
